node.statement: All remaining hypotheses needed to invoke lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum at base scale t_3 hold: A has ambient defect epsilon <= t_3; w:C^m->A is a non-unital extended t_3-inclusion with the same one-dimensional atomic images; epsilon_U,epsilon_V,d_U,d_V and both displayed reset-unit errors are at most t_3; t_3 <= W.e_cross; and the original inequalities d_U <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_U and d_V <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_V persist. Thus epsilon_R and every direct-envelope datum error are also dominated by t_3.
